from pocket_coffea.utils.configurator import Configurator

from pocket_coffea.workflows.base import BaseProcessorABC

parameters = defaults.get_default_parameters()

cut_5j = get_nObj_eq(5, coll="JetGood", name="5j")
cut_6j = get_nObj_min(6, coll="JetGood", name="6j")

njet_multicut = MultiCut(
    name="Njet",
    cuts=[cut_4j, cut_5j, cut_6j],
    cuts_names=["4j", "5j", "6j"],
)

# --- B-tag multiplicity binning: =2, >=3 b-jets of "BJetGood" ---
cut_2b = get_nObj_eq(2, coll="BJetGood", name="2b")
cut_3b = get_nObj_min(3, coll="BJetGood", name="3b")

nbtag_multicut = MultiCut(
    name="Nbtag",
    cuts=[cut_2b, cut_3b],
    cuts_names=["2b", "3b"],
)

# Cartesian combination of the two binnings: 3 x 2 = 6 categories

    multicuts=[njet_multicut, nbtag_multicut],
    common_cats=[],
)

cfg = Configurator(
    parameters=parameters,
    datasets={
        "jsons": ["datasets/signal_samples.json"],
        "filter": {
            "samples": ["signal"],
            "samples_exclude": [],
            "year": ["2018"],
        },
    },
    workflow=BaseProcessorABC,
    skim=[],
    preselections=[],
    categories=categorization,
    weights={
        "common": {
            "inclusive": ["genWeight", "lumi", "XS"],
            "bycategory": {},
        },
    },
    variations={
        "weights": {
            "common": {
                "inclusive": [],
                "bycategory": {},
            },
        },
    },
    variables={},
)

njet_labels = njet_multicut.cuts_names
nbtag_labels = nbtag_multicut.cuts_names
all_category_names = ["_".join(combo) for combo in product(njet_labels, nbtag_labels)]
